card.name: Dosing text in COVID-19 treatment labels
card.fires_on: Small connecting words, spaces before numbers, and partway through drug names in COVID-19 dosing and preparation instructions. It is strongest in remdesivir, tocilizumab, and lopinavir/ritonavir label text.

modes.label: Spaces and linking words
modes.description: A space before a number or a word like and/or or with, in COVID-19 treatment duration and dosing sentences.
modes.example: the recommended total treatment duration is<< >>10 days. ( 2.

modes.label: Inside drug and procedure names
modes.description: Partway through ritonavir or extracorporeal in COVID-19 drug text.
modes.example: Lopinavir and<< R>>itonavir Dosage Form Recommended Dos
